preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2*10**5 for N in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string N is between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.islower() and S.isalpha() for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T) for _ in range(1)])
preconditions.description: Each string S consists of lowercase english alphabets only.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(S) for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T) for _ in range(1)]) <= 2*10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings S over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == ''.join(sorted(S)) for i, S in enumerate([input().strip() for _ in range(T) for _ in range(1)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained by swapping adjacent characters in the input string.
